summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend regression for VIen-native Professional Profiles (Phase-2 + Phase-3 authz + self-onboarding). Backend pytest: 56/56 passing serially (test_professionals_phase2.py + test_professionals_authz.py + test_professionals_self_onboarding.py) via `python -m pytest ... -q -n0 -p no:randomly`. Confirmed via Mongo: legacy Access-origin professional_specialties=247 and professional_languages=158 UNCHANGED; new vien_professional_* counts match exactly (spheres=2, areas=32, specialties=115, credentials=90, languages=157, practice_types=24, primary_care_models=13, areas_of_practice=97). GET /api/professionals/taxonomy returns available=true with all-'v'-prefixed ids; Family Medicine has id vspec-family-medicine + area_id varea-physician; exactly one Portuguese=vlang-portuguese and one FRCPC=vcred-frcpc; primary_care_models includes 'Family Health Group (FHG)'. GET /api/professionals/areas-of-practice?specialty_id=vspec-family-medicine returns 97; ?specialty_id=vspec-cardiology returns []. Frontend (physician PAGUAYO via /signin?internal=1 with Newman2013_!): /internal/professionals shows prof-my-profile-card with ENABLED prof-edit-my-profile ('Set up my profile'), NO prof-add for physician. Clicking opens prof-editor-modal. Selected Sphere->Health (prof-sphere-opt-vsph-health), Professional Area->Physician (prof-area-opt-varea-physician) which correctly revealed the REQUIRED prof-registration field (label 'COLLEGE / PROFESSIONAL REGISTRATION NUMBER *'). Attempted Save with empty registration -> modal remains open (save blocked) though NO visible error toast is shown (minor UX gap). Filled registration=CPSO-QA-42, Specialty=Family Medicine (prof-specialty-opt-vspec-family-medicine), triggered load of exactly 97 prof-aop-opt-* options grouped, picked 2 (vaop-001 Comprehensive Family Medicine + vaop-002 General Primary Care); Credentials search 'CCFP' -> 3 hits, selected vcred-ccfp; Languages search 'Spanish' -> selected vlang-spanish; Practice type -> vpt-01 (Solo Practice); Ontario Primary Care Model -> vpcm-03 (Family Health Group (FHG)). Save -> success, modal closed, card flipped to 'Update my info' and shows ZZQAProf/CPSO-QA-42 subheading. Reopened editor: surname='ZZQAProf', registration='CPSO-QA-42' persisted; all chips (prof-aop-chip-vaop-001, prof-aop-chip-vaop-002, prof-credentials-chip-vcred-ccfp, prof-languages-chip-vlang-spanish, prof-practice-type-chip-vpt-01, prof-care-model-chip-vpcm-03) rendered with human NAMES (not raw ids). Directory list shows 1 prof-row; clicking opens view modal which renders 'Classification: Health -> Physician -> Family Medicine', 'Registration: CPSO-QA-42', 'Credentials: CCFP', 'Languages: Spanish', 'Areas of Practice: Comprehensive Family Medicine + General Primary Care', 'Practice Type: Solo Practice', 'Ontario Model: Family Health Group (FHG)' -- no raw v-prefixed ids visible. Admin & staff UI check: staff (staff@visita.demo) has NO prof-add and NO prof-edit-my-profile and NO Edit button in the view modal of another's profile (correct). Admin (kevinrodriguez9528@gmail.com) also has NO prof-add button (see UI bug below). Cleanup: mongo delete professional_profiles/editors/affiliations at end -> all 0; taxonomy + legacy collections untouched.

ui_bugs.issue: '+ Add Professional' button is MISSING for admin. Review request expected it visible for admin. The empty-state message even reads 'No professionals found. Use “Add Professional” to create one.' referencing a non-existent button. No element with data-testid=prof-add renders for admin either. Backend POST /api/professionals still exists and is admin-only, but there is no UI entry point.

Saving without required registration when Area=Physician silently keeps the modal open with no visible error toast. Server-side rejection is not surfaced to the user via a toast/inline error. (Prev iter checked something similar; still no visible toast in this run.)

action_items: Add a visible admin-only '+ Add Professional' button (data-testid=prof-add) on /internal/professionals that opens ProfessionalEditor in create (non-self) mode. Empty-state text already references it.

Surface a visible error toast (or inline field error) when saving the professional editor fails validation (e.g., missing registration for a required Professional Area) instead of just keeping the modal open.
critical_code_review_comments: Empty-state string in Professionals.jsx references an 'Add Professional' button that does not exist in the JSX. Either add the button (admin-only) or update the empty-state message.
editor Save button testid is `prof-editor-save`, not `prof-save`; keep that consistent in future test scripts and any documentation.
Save flow needs to expose backend validation errors to the UI (toast) — current failure path is silent.

Backend + Mongo state is exactly per spec: legacy professional_specialties=247 and professional_languages=158 untouched; all new taxonomy IDs are v-prefixed; DB has partial unique index on professional_profiles.linked_user_id enforcing at-most-one profile per user (verified by duplicate PUT /me test).

success_rate.frontend: physician self-onboarding 100%; admin/staff RBAC 100%; minor: missing '+ Add Professional' UI + missing save error toast

context_for_next_testing_agent: Editor Save button uses data-testid=prof-editor-save (NOT prof-save). Multi-select components: use `${testid}-search` for the search input and click options `${testid}-opt-<id>` then `${testid}-done`. Sphere/Area single-selects: click testid, then click `${testid}-opt-<id>`. Modern IDs used in the UI: vsph-health, varea-physician, vspec-family-medicine, vpcm-03 (FHG), vaop-001..vaop-097, vlang-spanish, vcred-ccfp, vpt-01. There is currently NO prof-add button in the DOM at all; if adding it, gate on user?.role === 'admin' in Professionals.jsx (canSelfEdit already exists at line 17).
rca of the issue: '+ Add Professional' missing: Professionals.jsx has no <button data-testid="prof-add"> — the JSX was likely trimmed when self-onboarding for physicians was introduced (PUT /me). Since the backend POST /api/professionals remains RBAC=admin, wiring up an admin-only button that opens <ProfessionalEditor initial={null} selfMode={false} /> restores the flow. Silent save-fail: ProfessionalEditor.save() probably swallows the 400 response without calling the toast helper — check the catch block near data-testid=prof-editor-save.
